Confirms: 6-3; Ginsburg majority joined by Roberts C.J., Scalia, Breyer, Sotomayor, Kagan; Thomas dissent joined by Alito and (except Part III) Kennedy; separate Kennedy and Alito dissents; argued Jan 21 2015, decided Apr 21 2015; March 27 2012 just after midnight; Nebraska (Highway 275); Officer Morgan Struble, K-9 officer; Dennys Rodriguez; Mercury Mountaineer veered onto shoulder; written warning issued and documents returned; ~7-8 minutes held after the warning waiting for a second officer; dog alerted; methamphetamine found; ~29 minutes total; mission rule; de minimis argument rejected; 'prolonged beyond the time reasonably required to complete the mission' (quoting Illinois v. Caballes, 543 U.S. 405); vacated and remanded to the Eighth Circuit to decide whether reasonable suspicion independently justified the extension.
